run_render_cross_id_driving: run cross ID avatar driving visualization using a trained autoencoder checkpoint and config
run_render_with_segment: render frames for a specific expression segment like EXP_eyes_blink_light_medium_hard_wink
run_render_with_camera: render avatar frames using a specific camera ID such as 401031
run_render_driver_driven_pair: render a driver avatar driving a driven avatar and save side-by-side comparison images
run_render_all_segments: render all available frames by omitting the segment ID argument
